description: React component 'ShowMore' for managing expandable/collapsible post text with overflow handling in Mattermost.

classes.name: ShowMore
classes.description: A React component that displays post text with toggle for showing more or less, handling overflow and resize events.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes component state, refs, and maxHeight based on props.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Sets up overflow check and resize event listener.

methods.name: componentDidUpdate
methods.description: Rechecks overflow when relevant props change.

methods.name: componentWillUnmount
methods.description: Removes event listeners and cancels animation frame.

methods.name: toggleCollapse
methods.description: Toggles the collapsed state of the post text.

methods.name: checkTextOverflow
methods.description: Checks if the text exceeds max height and updates overflow state.

methods.name: handleResize
methods.description: Handles window resize by rechecking overflow.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the component with toggle button and overflow handling.
